entities.summary: Kwak Dong-yeon is a South Korean actor. He first gained wide recognition in 2016 for starring in the historical drama Love in the Moonlight, and is also known for his roles in Gangnam Beauty (2018), Never Twice (2019), Vincenzo (2021), Big Mouth (2022), and Queen of Tears (2024).
